title: Cancellation of outer faces of a duplicated first repeat
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a linearly ordered type, $U:I\to\mathrm{Opens}(X)$ an open family [def-sc-zariski-site], $F$ an abelian-group presheaf, and $S$ a chosen terminal-open Čech product complex [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Let $p\ge0$, $s\in S^{p+1}(F)$, $t:\{0,\ldots,p+1\}\to I$, and $a\in\{0,\ldots,p+1\}$ satisfy the first-repeat predicate [def-pc-alternating-cech-sorting-operators]: $t_a=t_{a+1}$ and $t_b<t_{b+1}$ for every $b<a$. Let $q:\{0,\ldots,p+2\}\to\{0,\ldots,p+1\}$ duplicate position $a$, so $q(k)=k$ for $k\le a$ and $q(k)=k-1$ otherwise, and let $\delta_j$ omit position $j$. Write $\alpha^*$ for the index map of $S$. Assume additionally $p>0$ and that $t$ is nondecreasing. With $K_p=\mathrm{cechSecondSortingHom}(X,U,F,S,p)$ [def-pc-alternating-cech-sorting-operators], the outer-face sum satisfies $\sum_{0\le j\le p+2,\ j<a\ \mathrm{or}\ j>a+2}(-1)^a(-1)^j F(q^*)F(\delta_j^*)\bigl(s_{tq\delta_j}\bigr)=-\bigl(d^p(K_p s)\bigr)_t$, where $d^p$ is the alternating Čech restriction differential [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex].

source.place: Tag 01FM, equation-second-homotopy (20.23.6.2), and the verification omitted immediately after it

proof.text:
Write q for duplication at a. For each deletion j<a from the duplicated tuple,
pair its term with deletion j from t followed by duplication at a-1. For each
j>a+2, pair with deletion j-1 from t followed by duplication at a. The resulting
tuples agree and their restriction composites agree, since Opens is a thin
category. The sign products differ by a factor -1. In the incoming differential,
the terms deleting a and a+1 have the same tuple and equal restrictions and
opposite signs, so cancel, regardless of where that face's first repeat lies.
Every other incoming term is one of the paired terms just described. Distribute
the finite sums and cancel these pairs.

lean.statement: theorem cechRepeatOuterFaces (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type v} [LinearOrder I] (U : I → X.Opens) (F : X.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{w}) (S : SiteCechComplex U (fun i ↦ homOfLE (le_top : U i ≤ ⊤))) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (s : S.cochains F (p + 1)) (t : Fin (p + 2) → I) (ht : Monotone t) (a : Fin (p + 2)) (ha : cechFirstRepeat t a) : let q := cechJunction (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _) a (∑ j : Fin (p + 3), if j.val < a.val ∨ a.val + 2 < j.val then ((-1 : ℤ) ^ a.val * (-1 : ℤ) ^ j.val) • F.map (S.indexMap t q).op (F.map (S.indexMap (t ∘ q) j.succAbove).op (s ((t ∘ q) ∘ j.succAbove))) else 0) = -S.differentialValue F p ((cechSecondSortingHom X U F S p) s) t
